worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.summary: Fire a short-lived beam of intense light along the aim: it starts as a thin bright core, then opens from the core out into a limited fan. Every enemy inside the fan whose light path is not blocked takes special damage and has a high chance to lose 1 stage of Sp. Def; the user does not move or track, so enemies can step outside the beam.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.use.0: Sweep a rank of enemies straight ahead
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.use.1: Lower the Sp. Def of front-line foes with the family's highest chance
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.use.2: Let enemies who flank or fall behind you avoid the light
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.descriptio: Every enemy the fan sweeps takes about %1$s special damage, and each target is settled only once.
The beam reaches %1$s blocks along the aim, then opens from a thin core into a %2$s degree fan over %3$s; the user neither moves nor tracks.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s; while lowered it takes more special damage, until the target disengages or its stat stages are reset.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.growth.0: From level %1$s the light rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of beam range.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.preference: On: the fan narrows to 0.7, power ×1.18, sunder chance +0.06, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown — for burning through one target straight ahead. Off: a wider fan with base power and chance, for sweeping the ground ahead.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it approach from further away before releasing.

On: when other enemies stand inside the real fan in front of the target it prioritizes the light, sweeping a rank at once. Because it only counts the front, being surrounded from behind is not mistaken for a way out. Off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
